name: props_equilibrium_phi_sweep
source:
{ Chemical equilibrium: the 8x8 damped-Newton dissociation solve, swept over
  equivalence ratio, temperature and pressure. This is the single most iteration-
  sensitive kernel in the whole property layer -- any difference in damping,
  initial guess or convergence test shows up here first, and nowhere else.
  Every species of the product pool is read at each of the three phi values. }
x_co2_lean  = eq_molefraction('CH4', 0.6, 2000, 101325, 'CO2')
x_co_lean   = eq_molefraction('CH4', 0.6, 2000, 101325, 'CO')
x_h2o_lean  = eq_molefraction('CH4', 0.6, 2000, 101325, 'H2O')
x_h2_lean   = eq_molefraction('CH4', 0.6, 2000, 101325, 'H2')
x_oh_lean   = eq_molefraction('CH4', 0.6, 2000, 101325, 'OH')
x_h_lean    = eq_molefraction('CH4', 0.6, 2000, 101325, 'H')
x_o_lean    = eq_molefraction('CH4', 0.6, 2000, 101325, 'O')
x_o2_lean   = eq_molefraction('CH4', 0.6, 2000, 101325, 'O2')
x_n2_lean   = eq_molefraction('CH4', 0.6, 2000, 101325, 'N2')

x_co2_st    = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.0, 2200, 101325, 'CO2')
x_co_st     = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.0, 2200, 101325, 'CO')
x_h2o_st    = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.0, 2200, 101325, 'H2O')
x_h2_st     = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.0, 2200, 101325, 'H2')
x_oh_st     = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.0, 2200, 101325, 'OH')
x_h_st      = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.0, 2200, 101325, 'H')
x_o_st      = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.0, 2200, 101325, 'O')
x_o2_st     = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.0, 2200, 101325, 'O2')
x_n2_st     = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.0, 2200, 101325, 'N2')

x_co2_rich  = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.3, 2200, 101325, 'CO2')
x_co_rich   = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.3, 2200, 101325, 'CO')
x_h2o_rich  = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.3, 2200, 101325, 'H2O')
x_h2_rich   = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.3, 2200, 101325, 'H2')
x_oh_rich   = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.3, 2200, 101325, 'OH')
x_o2_rich   = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.3, 2200, 101325, 'O2')

{ temperature sweep: dissociation switches on somewhere around 1800-2000 K }
x_co_1200   = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.0, 1200, 101325, 'CO')
x_co_1600   = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.0, 1600, 101325, 'CO')
x_co_2000   = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.0, 2000, 101325, 'CO')
x_co_2400   = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.0, 2400, 101325, 'CO')
x_co_2800   = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.0, 2800, 101325, 'CO')
x_co_3200   = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.0, 3200, 101325, 'CO')
x_oh_3200   = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.0, 3200, 101325, 'OH')
x_h_3200    = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.0, 3200, 101325, 'H')

{ pressure sweep at fixed T: Le Chatelier suppresses dissociation with P }
x_co_p01    = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.0, 2600, 10132.5, 'CO')
x_co_p1     = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.0, 2600, 101325, 'CO')
x_co_p10    = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.0, 2600, 1013250, 'CO')
x_co_p50    = eq_molefraction('CH4', 1.0, 2600, 5066250, 'CO')

{ other fuels }
x_co2_c8    = eq_molefraction('C8H18', 1.0, 2300, 101325, 'CO2')
x_co_c3     = eq_molefraction('C3H8', 1.0, 2300, 101325, 'CO')

{ equilibrium flame temperature (secant, bracketed 1000..3200, clamp to 3500) }
taf_ch4_1   = AdiabaticFlameTempEq('CH4', 1.0, 298.15, 101325)
taf_ch4_08  = AdiabaticFlameTempEq('CH4', 0.8, 298.15, 101325)
taf_ch4_12  = AdiabaticFlameTempEq('CH4', 1.2, 298.15, 101325)
taf_ch4_10p = AdiabaticFlameTempEq('CH4', 1.0, 298.15, 1013250)
taf_c8_1    = AdiabaticFlameTempEq('C8H18', 1.0, 298.15, 101325)
taf_alias   = FlameTemp_Eq('CH4', 1.0, 298.15, 101325)
